variants.prompt: On the deck of a luxurious yacht, a sultry seductress models a daring leather bodysuit, the glossy black material hugging her every curve. Emerald eyes glint with confidence as she strikes a provocative pose, one stiletto-clad foot hooked on the railing. A gold cuff gleams on her wrist as the sun sets behind her, casting long shadows and illuminating the ocean's gentle waves. A shallow depth of field isolates her in a world of sleek lines and nautical blues.
